purpose: Fixed member answers and checkable tone rules for the Get to know me interview. For the PZ-10 eval. No model runs here.

assertions.no_list_repeat: The reply does not repeat the member's answer as a list or as bullets.
assertions.one_question: The reply holds exactly one question mark.
assertions.no_tool_words: The reply holds none of: tool, profile_, mark, marked, saved, saving, limit, area.
assertions.no_numbering: The reply holds no 'Question 2 of 3', no '1.' and no '#1' style numbering.
assertions.same_language: The reply uses the language of the member's answer.

cases.expect: One light follow-up or the next question, in a short reply.

cases.answer: I run operations for a small manufacturing firm. Most of my week goes to vendor calls, production planning and chasing invoices. On Fridays I review cash with our accountant, and I travel to the plant twice a month.
cases.expect: One specific reaction to a detail, then one question. No list of the answer.
One light follow-up on the same area before moving on.

cases.answer: Can you also book my flight to Delhi for Monday?
cases.expect: Handle the request or say it comes next. Do not ignore it, and do not number the questions.
